subject: history
concept: Understanding how colonization changed both the colonizing nations and the colonized regions
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's complete-truth principle — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines a simplified before/after map showing a region before and during colonization
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described change to whether it affected the colonizing nation, the colonized region, or both
exercise.abstract: Student explains one real effect of colonization on a described region, honestly including difficult effects

misconception_flags: describes colonization in only positive or only negative terms rather than its full, complex real effects

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
